title: APIs
subtitle: Manage your API definitions and configurations.

sync.savedButPending: {saved}. The gateway sync is still pending — its status updates on this page.

notFound.title: API not found
notFound.message: This API does not exist or was deleted.

keysTab.empty: No keys have been issued for this API.

config.trackingOff: Requests are not recorded in analytics

form.editDescription: Changes are synced to the gateway on save.
form.createDescription: Add a new API definition to the gateway.
form.slugLockedDescription: The slug cannot be changed after creation.
form.enableCorsDescription: Let browsers call this API from other origins.
form.allowCredentialsDescription: Let browsers send cookies and auth headers.
form.doNotTrackDescription: Do not record requests to this API in analytics.

errors.nameTooShort: Name must be at least 2 characters
errors.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens
errors.urlMustStartWithScheme: URL must start with http:// or https://

delete.title: Delete API?
delete.description: This permanently deletes <bold>{name}</bold> and removes it from the gateway. APIs with active keys cannot be deleted; revoke those keys first.

clients.description: Consumers authenticate with the OAuth2 client_credentials grant.
clients.empty: No OAuth2 clients have been issued for this API.
clients.createSheetDescription: Machine credentials for this API, with optional per-client limits.
clients.nameTooLong: Name must be at most 100 characters
clients.wholeNumberError: {label} must be a whole number of at least {min}
clients.copyError: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
clients.secretDialogDescription: The client secret is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later. Store it somewhere safe.
clients.getTokenHint: Send the returned <code1>access_token</code1> as <code2>Authorization: Bearer <token></code2> when calling this API.
clients.revokeDescription: {clientLabel} stops working immediately — its gateway policy is removed, so tokens it already holds are rejected too. This cannot be undone.
clients.rotateError: Failed to rotate the client secret

endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.description: Derived from the API's generated OAS document — not hand-entered.
endpoints.empty: No endpoints yet. They appear once a per-request middleware (URL rewrite, circuit breaker, mock response, body transform or schema validation) is configured.

traffic.title: Traffic limits
traffic.description: Rate limit, throttling, timeouts, request size and the circuit breaker.
traffic.retryLimitDescription: Queued retries once the rate limit is hit. 0 disables throttling.
traffic.timeoutDescription: The gateway answers 504 past this. Leave blank for no limit.
traffic.sizeLimitDescription: Capped at {max} bytes, the edge's own limit. Leave blank for no limit.
traffic.sizeLimitRangeError: Must be between 1 and the edge's body-size limit
traffic.circuitBreakerDescription: Trips after enough errors in a sample, then cools down before trying again.

loadBalancing.title: Load balancing
loadBalancing.description: Extra upstream targets traffic is spread across, beyond the API's own upstream URL.
loadBalancing.skipUnavailableDescription: Route around a target the uptime test has marked down.

uptimeTests.title: Uptime tests
uptimeTests.description: Probes the gateway runs on an interval to compute this API's health status.
uptimeTests.probesDescription: One "url method timeoutSeconds" per line (method and timeout are optional). At most {max}.
uptimeTests.lineFormatError: Each line must start with an http(s) URL, with an optional method and timeout

headerTransform.title: Header transform
headerTransform.description: Headers injected into, or stripped from, the request and the response.

urlRewrite.title: URL rewrite
urlRewrite.description: Rewrites the stripped request path before it reaches the upstream.
urlRewrite.patternDescription: Regex matched against the stripped path.

bodyTransform.title: Body transform
bodyTransform.description: A Go template applied to the request and/or response body.
bodyTransform.templateDescription: A Go template. Its output replaces the body.

mock.title: Mock response
mock.description: Short-circuits the request — the upstream is never called.
mock.codeRangeError: Enter a status code between 100 and 599

cache.title: Response cache
cache.description: Caches upstream responses, plus an on-demand invalidation action.
cache.allSafeRequestsDescription: GET, HEAD and OPTIONS requests, regardless of response code.
cache.invalidateNowDescription: Drops this API's cached responses on every gateway node.
cache.invalidateNoOpToast: Nothing to invalidate — the cache is already empty

detailedRecording.title: Detailed recording
detailedRecording.description: Full request/response detail for this API's analytics.
detailedRecording.enableDescription: Off by default — detailed records carry headers and bodies.

ipAccess.title: IP access control
ipAccess.description: Allow or deny requests by client IP, evaluated after the edge normalises the address.
ipAccess.oneLinePerEntry: One IP or CIDR per line.

upstreamMtls.title: Upstream mTLS
upstreamMtls.description: Present a client certificate to this API's own upstream when it demands one. Not client-certificate auth at the gateway.
upstreamMtls.hint: Leave as None if the upstream does not require a client certificate.

requestValidation.title: Request validation
requestValidation.description: A JSON Schema the request body must satisfy. A violation is rejected by the gateway with 422.
requestValidation.mustBeObject: The schema must be a JSON object

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: Which auth scheme this API enforces, and which header carries the credential.
authentication.headerNameDescription: Defaults to Authorization. Setting this replaces that header rather than adding an alternative.
authentication.headerNameInvalid: Use only letters, digits and hyphens
authentication.hmacParked: HMAC signing is not available yet — the mapper exists, but no signing-string variant has been verified working end to end.

testRequest.title: Test request
testRequest.description: Runs a sample request against this API's own stored definition.
testRequest.targetUrlDescription: Test against a different upstream without editing the live API. Checked against the same deny list as the API's own upstream URL.
testRequest.error: Failed to run the test request
